title: gdpr.section.erased
description: This module's erasure receipt: what it removed for the named subject, echoing the correlation_id it was asked with. Emitted in the same transaction as the erasure (outbox discipline), so a rolled-back erasure never produces a receipt.

counts.description: What was removed, by kind: contacts, push_tokens, settings, delivery_claims (destroyed) and log_rows_anonymized (kept as a delivery audit trail, stripped of the person).
